description: This file defines the CounterGrain class, which is a grain implementation in an Orleans distributed system. It manages tracking of grains with counters, retrieves total counter values, and schedules reporting based on configuration options.

classes.name: CounterGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class responsible for tracking grains with counters and providing aggregated data.

methods.name: GetRunDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration for which the grain is configured to run.

methods.name: GetTotalCounterValue
methods.description: Aggregates and returns the total counter value from all tracked grains.

methods.name: Track
methods.description: Adds a grain to the tracking list for counter aggregation.

methods.name: WaitTimeForReport
methods.description: Calculates the wait time until the next report based on options.
